description: Land Acquisition - Abesekaragama, Angunukolapelessa D/S Division, Hambantota District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1853/19 of 12.03.2014 by Kelaniya D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific plots of land being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains descriptions of land lots, their names, types (e.g., garden, paddy field, road), extents, and claimant information. This falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
